raw_meta_yaml:
# Higher number -> Always prioritize "all" variant over "novtk" variant
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "8.0.1"
  occt_version: "8.0.1"
  build: 0
  # this is where the final build number is calculated depending on the matrix of python/mpi variants
  variant_num: ${{ 100 if variant == 'novtk' else 200 }}
  build_num: ${{ build + variant_num }}

package:
  name: pythonocc-core
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/tpaviot/pythonocc-core/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 77345f333614374911d946a37bf89c3bbf2d285117d3d37b4197fcd28dc598a3

build:
  number: ${{ build_num }}
  string: ${{ variant }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_num }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ninja
    - cmake
    - swig
  host:
    - python
    - occt ==${{ occt_version }} *${{ variant }}*
    - numpy
    - if: linux
      then: libgl-devel
    - if: linux
      then: xorg-libxi
  run:
    - python
    - occt ==${{ occt_version }} *${{ variant }}*
    - svgwrite
  run_constraints:
    - occt ==${{ occt_version }} *${{ variant }}*

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - OCC
        - OCC.Core.BRepPrimAPI
      pip_check: false
    files:
      source:
        - test
    requirements:
      run:
        - pyqt >=5
        - pytest
        - mypy

about:
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: python bindings for opencascade (occt)
  description: |
    pythonocc is a python package whose purpose is
    to provide 3D modeling features. It is intended
    to CAD/PDM/PLM and BIM related development.
  homepage: https://github.com/tpaviot/pythonocc-core
  repository: https://github.com/tpaviot/pythonocc-core

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - oursland
    - krande
    - looooo
